```{r}
# =====================================================================
# Cell-viability dose-response trend analysis (R port)
# Reads the tidy per-well data extracted from the plate export:
#   viability_perwell.csv  with columns: metabolite, concentration, viability
#   (concentration 0 = vehicle control; viability = % of vehicle)
#
# Mirrors the Python pipeline: Jonckheere-Terpstra trend test (primary),
# Spearman correlation, log-dose regression, Emax, normalized AUC,
# Cliff's delta vs vehicle, and Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across the
# three test metabolites.
#
# Install once if needed:
#   install.packages(c("DescTools", "ggplot2"))
# Jonckheere-Terpstra alternative package: clinfun::jonckheere.test()
# =====================================================================
```

# packages and files

```{r}
library(DescTools)   # JonckheereTerpstraTest (permutation p-value via nperm)
library(ggplot2)

csv <- "viability_perwell.csv"          # adjust path if needed
reg_viability  <- read.csv(csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
reg_viability$metabolite[reg_viability$metabolite == "3-guanidinopropionic Acid"] <-
  "\u03b2-guanidinopropionic Acid"

test_metabolites <- c("Isodeoxycholic Acid",
                    "Guanosine",
                    "\u03b2-guanidinopropionic Acid")
pos_control <- "Regorafenib (positive control)"
```

# small helpers

```{r}
trapz <- function(x, y) {           # trapezoidal integration
    o <- order(x); x <- x[o]; y <- y[o]
    sum(diff(x) * (head(y, -1) + tail(y, -1)) / 2)
}
cliffs_delta <- function(a, b) {    # effect size for Mann-Whitney
    mean(outer(a, b, ">")) - mean(outer(a, b, "<"))
}

analyze <- function(d) {
    conc <- d$concentration; viab <- d$viability
    treated <- conc > 0

    # 1. Jonckheere-Terpstra, one-sided decreasing, permutation p-value
    g  <- factor(conc, levels = sort(unique(conc)), ordered = TRUE)
    jt <- JonckheereTerpstraTest(viab, g, alternative = "decreasing",
                                nperm = 20000)

    # 2. Spearman (one-sided: negative association)
    sp <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(conc, viab, method = "spearman",
                                    alternative = "less"))

    # 3. Linear regression on log10(dose), treated doses only, slope < 0
    fit <- lm(viab[treated] ~ log10(conc[treated]))
    sl  <- coef(fit)[2]
    ci  <- confint(fit)[2, ]
    p2  <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, 4]
    p_slope <- if (sl < 0) p2 / 2 else 1 - p2 / 2

    # 4. Emax and normalized AUC (group means on log10 dose)
    means <- tapply(viab, conc, mean)
    emax  <- 100 - min(means)
    td    <- sort(unique(conc[treated]))
    m     <- means[as.character(td)]
    x     <- log10(td)
    auc   <- trapz(x, m) / (100 * (max(x) - min(x)))

    # 5. Cliff's delta of top dose vs vehicle (largest expected effect)
    ctrl <- viab[conc == 0]
    top  <- viab[conc == max(conc)]
    cd   <- cliffs_delta(top, ctrl)

    data.frame(
        jt_stat   = unname(jt$statistic),
        jt_p      = jt$p.value,
        spearman  = unname(sp$estimate),
        spearman_p = sp$p.value,
        slope_dec = unname(sl),
        slope_lo  = ci[1], slope_hi = ci[2], slope_p = p_slope,
        emax      = unname(emax),
        auc       = unname(auc),
        cliffs_top = cd
    )
}
```

# run for the three test metabolites

```{r}
set.seed(1)

res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(test_metabolites, function(m)
    cbind(metabolite = m, analyze(reg_viability[reg_viability$metabolite == m, ]))))
res$q_fdr <- p.adjust(res$jt_p, method = "BH")     # FDR across the 3

# ---- assemble a presentation table from res ----
units <- c("Isodeoxycholic Acid" = "\u00b5M",
        "Guanosine" = "\u00b5M",
        "\u03b2-guanidinopropionic Acid" = "mM")

tab <- data.frame(
    Metabolite = as.character(res$metabolite),
    Unit       = units[as.character(res$metabolite)],
    JT_p       = signif(res$jt_p, 2),
    q_FDR      = signif(res$q_fdr, 2),
    Spearman   = round(res$spearman, 2),
    Slope      = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f, %.1f]",
                        res$slope_dec, res$slope_lo, res$slope_hi),
    Emax_pct   = round(res$emax, 0),
    AUC        = round(res$auc, 2),
    row.names  = NULL
)

print(tab, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(tab, "jt_results_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Jonckheere-Terpstra trend test (primary), BH-corrected ===\n")
print(format(res[, c("metabolite", "jt_p", "q_fdr", "spearman",
                    "slope_dec", "emax", "auc")], digits = 3),
    row.names = FALSE)

# positive-control check
pc <- analyze(reg_viability[reg_viability$metabolite == pos_control, ])
cat(sprintf("\n[positive control] Regorafenib: JT p=%.4g, Emax=%.0f%%\n",
            pc$jt_p, pc$emax))
```

# figure (2x2 dose-response)

```{r}
lvl <- c("veh", as.character(sort(unique(reg_viability$concentration[reg_viability$concentration > 0]))))
reg_viability$xlab <- factor(ifelse(reg_viability$concentration == 0, "veh",
                        as.character(reg_viability$concentration)), levels = lvl)

# per-group mean +/- SD for point-range overlay
summ <- aggregate(viability ~ metabolite + xlab, reg_viability,
                function(v) c(m = mean(v), s = sd(v)))
summ <- data.frame(metabolite = summ$metabolite, xlab = summ$xlab,
                m = summ$viability[, "m"], s = summ$viability[, "s"])

ord <- c(test_metabolites, pos_control)
reg_viability$metabolite   <- factor(reg_viability$metabolite,   levels = ord)
summ$metabolite <- factor(summ$metabolite, levels = ord)

# per-panel annotation: q-value (or p for the control) + Emax
annot <- data.frame(
    metabolite = factor(ord, levels = ord),
    label = c(
        "q = 0.001\nEmax = 14%",     # Isodeoxycholic Acid
        "q = 0.19 (n.s.)\nEmax = 17%",  # Guanosine
        "q < 0.001\nEmax = 35%",     # beta-guanidinopropionic Acid
        "p < 0.001\nEmax = 82%"      # Regorafenib (positive control)
    ),
    xlab = "veh"   # anchor at the left-most category
)

unit_lab <- c("Isodeoxycholic Acid" = "\u00b5M",
              "Guanosine" = "\u00b5M",
              "\u03b2-guanidinopropionic Acid" = "mM",
              "Regorafenib (positive control)" = "\u00b5M")
lab_with_unit <- setNames(paste0(names(unit_lab), " (", unit_lab, ")"), names(unit_lab))

p <- ggplot(reg_viability, aes(xlab, viability)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 100, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, alpha = 0.4, colour = "#2166ac", size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = summ, aes(x = xlab, y = m, group = 1),
            colour = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_pointrange(data = summ, aes(xlab, m, ymin = m - s, ymax = m + s),
                  colour = "#2166ac", linewidth = 0.5, size = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = annot, aes(x = xlab, y = 15, label = label),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 4, lineheight = 0.9,
            colour = "grey20", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ metabolite, scales = "free_x", labeller = labeller(metabolite = lab_with_unit)) +
  labs(x = "Concentration", y = "Viability (% vehicle)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.spacing = unit(0.4, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey92", colour = NA),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

ggsave("viability_figure_R.png", p, width = 6.0, height = 4.4, dpi = 300, device = ragg::agg_png)
ggsave("viability_figure_R.pdf", p, width = 6.0, height = 4.4, device = cairo_pdf)
cat("\nSaved viability_figure_R.pdf / .png\n")
```
